description: The file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget called CustomListScreen, which displays a list of tasks associated with a specific list. It handles loading tasks from a database, displaying them, updating task completion status, and deleting tasks or entire lists. It also provides navigation to add new tasks or view individual task details.

classes.name: CustomListScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing a screen that displays and manages tasks within a specific list.

classes.name: _CustomListScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI and data for CustomListScreen, including task loading, updating, and deletion logic.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously loads all notes and specific tasks for the current list from the database and updates the state.
